cell_line.evidence: MDA‐MB‐231 cells were purchased from ATCC (HTB‐26) and grown in DMEM media (Merck Life Science A/S, Søborg, DK), supplemented with 1% penicillin/streptomycin (Merck Life Science A/S, Søborg, DK) and 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Roskilde, DK) at 37°C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere.
A total of 5 μg of human recombinant CD74 protein, expressed in HEK cells, was reduced with 10 mM TCEP and alkylated with 40 mM CAA for 10 min at 95°C.
